## Check the Tire Air Pressure

### WARNING

Avoid injury!

Improperly maintained tires and rim parts can cause explosive separation of the wheels.

- Mounting and dismounting of the tires into and from the rim must be performed by an authorized person using proper equipment.
- Avoid inflating the tires above the recommended tire air pressure.
- Avoid standing in front of or over a tire assembly during inflation.
- Always use a clip-on chuck and extension hose long enough for the tire to be inflated from a safe distance.
- Avoid attempting to weld or apply heat into a rim and tire assembly.
  - welding can structurally weaken or deform the rim
  - heat can cause an increase in tire air pressure and result in an explosion

### IMPORTANT

When checking tire air pressure of liquid filled tires:

- rotate the tire placing the valve stem on top position
- the preceding practice prevents the liquid from escaping through the valve stem
